newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close lower on political unrest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close lower on political unrest.

text.p: Pakistani stocks, which gained slightly on short-covering in early trade, closed lower on profit-taking, political uncertainty and a shortage of funds on Tuesday, now clearing day instead of Monday, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 15 points, or 1.06 percent, lower at 1,394.16 points, after rising to 1,413.29 in early trade. Losers led gainers 153 to 83.

Profit-taking sparked bearish sentiment and dragged down the index in the afternoon, dealer Majid Chapra said. HUBCO fell 0.85 rupee to 32.40, PTCL 0.15 to 26.85, ICI 0.60 to 18.60, PSO 3.0 to 287 and DS Fibre 2.0 to 30. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
